verdict.rationale: Fellow's marketing page states that admins can set organization-wide policies for how meetings are accessed, while giving teams control over what they share. That is a thin, first-party nod to admin-governed sharing. Nothing documents private-by-default notes, granular link/folder/workspace permission levels, or an admin view of what has been shared; the Super Admin API's export/delete and MCP access-scoping are adjacent features and earn no credit here. missing for 10: private-by-default note behavior, granular link/folder/workspace permission controls, admin visibility/reporting into shared content, in-depth docs or independent corroboration.

support.subject: As an IT admin, sharing is controlled — private-by-default notes, granular link/folder/workspace permissions, and admin visibility into what's shared
